notes: diesel 2 with the sqlite feature (bundled SQLite), :memory: opened once: sql_query for CREATE TABLE, insert_into().values(&Vec<NewUser>), then filter().order().select(User::as_select()).load().
details: Diesel has no call that creates a table from the declared schema (its CLI runs migrations), so CREATE TABLE and DROP TABLE are raw SQL, as for drizzle-orm. The result rows are read into tuples inside the call; the JSON for the verifier is built outside it.
